notes: «من أبي فلم أحفظه» says Asim heard it from his father but did not keep it; the report is carried by «فقومه لي واقد», so Asim's father is not written as a link here.
«عن أبيه» and «سمعت أبي» name Waqid's father twice in succession: one relation link.
The Companion is the «عبد الله» of «قال عبد الله»; his full name is not in the text and is not completed.
